### ⭐ Streamproof 0.3.2 release
Streamproof is a fabric windows-only mod that lets you hide specific things from rendering in OBS/Medal

>[!WARNING]
>OBS must be using "Game Capture" with mode "Capture specific window".
>Leave "Use anti-cheat compatibility hook" unchecked, and target the `javaw` Minecraft window.

>[!CAUTION]
>Do not use the "Fullscreen Application" option, or the "Screen Capture" which are both unsupported

# Features
```diff
main
+ Hide F3 Overlay
+ Hide Maps (holding maps or when on an item frame, works with map art as well)
+ Hide Debug Hitboxes
+ Hide Chat Messages
+ Hide Chat Input
+ Hide Scoreboard
+ Hide Player List
+ Hide Subtitles
+ Streamproof Screenshots Toggle
+ Streamproof All Toggle

extras
+ Hide Apple Skin's Overlay
+ Hide Uku's Armor HUD
+ Hide InventoryHudPlus's armor overlay
+ Hide InventoryHudPlus's potion overlay
+ Hide InventoryHudPlus's inventory overlay
+ Hide XaerosMinimap's minimap hud
+ Hide XaerosMinimap's waypoints
+ Hide Litematica's world overlay
+ Hide Litematica's gui overlay
+ Hide Streamproof ImGui menu
```

# Changes
```diff
+ Streamproof Litematica World Overlay Support
+ Streamproof Litematica Gui Overlay Support
```

# Fixes
```diff
+ Fixed Uku's Armor HUD's streamproof mixin incompatibility with Litematica by using MixinSquared instead of the unstable profiler push pop hook
```

### References
[ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)
[AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin)
[Uku's Armor Hud](https://modrinth.com/mod/ukus-armor-hud)
[InventoryHudPlus](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventoryhudplus)
[XaerosMinimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)
[Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback)
[Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica)
[MixinSquared](https://github.com/Bawnorton/MixinSquared)

### ⭐ Streamproof 0.2.0 release
Streamproof is a fabric windows-only mod that lets you hide specific things from rendering in OBS

>[!WARNING]
>OBS must be using "Game Capture" and targeting the `javaw` Minecraft process instead of "Fullscreen Application" option, or the "Screen Capture" which are both unsupported.

# Features
```diff
main
+ Hide F3 Overlay from OBS
+ Hide Maps (Buggy, holding maps or when on an item frame, works with map art as well) from OBS
+ Hide Debug Hitboxes from OBS
+ Hide Chat Messages from OBS
+ Hide Chat Input from OBS
+ Hide Scoreboard from OBS
+ Hide Player List from OBS
+ Hide Subtitles from OBS

extras
+ Hide InventoryHudPlus's armor overlay from OBS
+ Hide InventoryHudPlus's potion overlay from OBS
+ Hide InventoryHudPlus's inventory overlay from OBS
+ Hide XaerosMinimap's minimap hud from OBS
+ Hide XaerosMinimap's waypoints from OBS
+ Hide Streamproof ImGui menu from OBS
```

# Changes
```diff
- Removed unstable unmaintainable annoying hiding system that was deferring draws
+ Implemented a new FBO switching system for redirecting draw calls, more stable and clean
+ Streamproof map rendering (mapart included)
+ Streamproof scoreboard rendering
+ Streamproof player list rendering
+ Streamproof subtitles rendering
```

# Fixes
```
+ Should be compatible with Flashback now
```

[XaerosMinimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)
[Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback)
